defs.def: the area that you are in or the area near a particular place 所在地；邻近的地方

ex.s: He loved biking around his neighbourhood but grew upset seeing that many plastic bottles littered the parks and sidewalks.
ex.t: 他喜欢在社区周围骑自行车，但看到许多塑料瓶散落在公园和人行道上，感到很沮丧。

ex.s: There are two parks less than 10 minutes’ walk from home where neighbourhood children gather to play.
ex.t: 离家不到10分钟步行路程就有两个公园，附近的孩子聚在那里玩耍。

ex.s: Regardless of the weather or the distance, Paul Wilson will make sure low-income students in his neighbourhood arrive at their college classes on time.
ex.t: 无论天气如何，也无论距离多远，Paul Wilson都会确保他所在社区低收入家庭的学生准时到达大学课堂。
